text:
maria: Hey team — I noticed a weird docsite build failure on the PR that landed the SDK examples rename. Docusaurus linkcheck is complaining about a missing anchor for `sdk:quickstart` even though the heading is there in MDX.

raj: can you paste the exact error from CI?

docs-bot: build #1482 failed — linkcheck: broken fragment `#sdkquickstart` referenced from /docs/clients/sdk.md -> /docs/guides/quickstart.md:423

maria: here's the log snippet:

```
LinkCheckError: Broken fragment '#sdkquickstart' in /docs/guides/quickstart.md (target file: /docs/clients/sdk.md)
  at /repo/node_modules/docusaurus-link-checker/index.js:52:13
```

alex: my guess: the MDX heading has an emoji + emoji shortcode (⚙️ Quickstart) and our slugifier strips emoji differently between link generator & linkchecker. I hit this before with non-ascii chars.

sam: any chance the file rename introduced a BOM or soft-hyphen? those can change sluggen.

maria: checked — no BOM. the heading is `## ⚙️ SDK quickstart` and the link in clients/sdk.md was `[#sdkquickstart](/docs/guides/quickstart.md#sdkquickstart)` (missing the hyphen and lowercasing mismatch)

raj: ok, quick repro locally: `yarn start` then click link -> 404 anchor. docusaurus auto-generated id is `sdk-quickstart` (dash). So link should be `#sdk-quickstart`.

maria: ugh — where did the dash go? the PR author probably created a hand-rolled anchor.

alex: propose we update link in clients/sdk.md to use full relative link: `/docs/guides/quickstart#sdk-quickstart` and add a small test to our docs lint: a regex that compares generated slugs to explicit anchors.

sam: +1 for lint. For quick fix I'll open a tiny PR to change the link and add a note in the PR body.

maria: thanks. Also opened an issue for the slugifier inconsistency: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/612

docs-bot: PR #1976 created by sam: fix(sdk-link): correct anchor and add docs-lint for anchors — CI queued

raj: added a quick unit test to verify emoji stripping matches slugify in docusaurus config. If CI passes, we can cherry-pick into the release branch.

maria: sounds good. @sam can you add one-line changelog? we need to ship before tomorrow's deploy window.

sam: will do. ping me if CI flakes, I'll rollback.

maria: :thumbsup:
